note: A3.3 client request-path normalisation. A TS client (absolute URL + query string) and a Dart client (absolute URL) call the same Go chi server. Deliberately legacy-only (no `cells`): typescript/http_client and dart/http_client are already measured by ts-http-fetch and dart-http-dio; this is their absolute-URL twin. Three dirs => generate_many => three RepoIds.
